import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
try:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv', low_memory=False)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Dataset not found. Please ensure 'data/dogs_zurich.csv' is in the correct directory.")
    exit()

# --- Data Preparation ---
# Standardize breed names: lowercase and strip whitespace
df['Rasse1Text'] = df['Rasse1Text'].str.lower().str.strip()

# Replace common mixed-breed variations into a single category
mischling_variations = ['mischling', 'mischling, klein', 'mischling, mittel', 'mischling, gross']
df['Rasse1Text'] = df['Rasse1Text'].replace(mischling_variations, 'mischling (mixed breed)')

# Find the top 10 most popular breeds overall to focus the visualization
# We exclude 'unbekannt' (unknown) from this calculation
top_breeds = df[df['Rasse1Text'] != 'unbekannt']['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index

# Filter the DataFrame to include only these top breeds
df_top_breeds = df[df['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Group by year and breed to count the number of dogs
breed_trends = df_top_breeds.groupby(['StichtagDatJahr', 'Rasse1Text']).size().reset_index(name='count')

# --- Visualization ---
# Set the style and create the figure
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 9))

# Create the line plot with a clear color palette
palette = sns.color_palette("tab10", n_colors=len(top_breeds))
lineplot = sns.lineplot(
    data=breed_trends,
    x='StichtagDatJahr',
    y='count',
    hue='Rasse1Text',
    hue_order=top_breeds, # Ensure legend order matches popularity
    ax=ax,
    palette=palette,
    linewidth=2.5,
    marker='o',
    markersize=5
)

# --- Customization for Clarity and Insight ---
# Set title and labels with descriptive text
ax.set_title('Popularity Trends of Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=20, pad=25, weight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=14, labelpad=15)
ax.set_ylabel('Number of Registered Dogs', fontsize=14, labelpad=15)

# Improve tick formatting
ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=12)
# Ensure x-axis ticks are integers representing years
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MaxNLocator(integer=True))
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Enhance the legend
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
# Capitalize labels for better readability
capitalized_labels = [label.replace('(mixed breed)', '(Mixed Breed)').title() for label in labels]
legend = ax.legend(
    handles,
    capitalized_labels,
    title='Dog Breed',
    title_fontsize='13',
    fontsize='11',
    bbox_to_anchor=(1.03, 1),
    loc='upper left'
)

# Add a subtle grid
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
ax.grid(axis='x', linestyle=':', alpha=0.5)

# Remove top and right spines for a cleaner look
sns.despine(ax=ax)

# Adjust layout to prevent labels from being cut off
fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.85, 1])

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
